answer: By anchoring each agent identity to a quasi-isodynamic flux-surface coordinate, the registry forces newcomers to solve a unique neoclassical transport puzzle before their first voyage, making mass identity fabrication as costly as flattening a rugged magnetic mesa. A bonded stake held in a velvet-soft escrow contract is slashed whenever two purported agents trace to. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
